company.name: Adapty.io
company.industry: Mobile subscription analytics + paywall SaaS (iOS/Android, expanding to web)
company.icp_fit: A — primary ICP (120 emp, cloud-native, sensitive subscription/payment data, no CISO, founder-led)

routing_rationale: Builder-CTO with published voice on infrastructure-as-product. Title overlap with Gregory Komissarov resolved: Kirill is CPO/CTO Co-Founder; Gregory is Head of Development (NOT CTO — was a data-scraper artifact in source CSV). Distinct angle: extending his 'infrastructure as product' framing one layer down to the control-plane that holds the new six-PSP integration layer together.

research_summary.trigger_event: FunnelFox web paywall launch May 12, 2025 — 12 days after Apple antitrust ruling — integrating six PSPs (Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, Braintree, Adyen, Solidgate). Combined with his October 2025 published article on infrastructure reliability, this is a Type 1 trigger.
research_summary.key_insight: His published verbatim line 'Since infrastructure is our product, reliability isn't a feature. That's the whole point.' was the strongest individual signal. Email paraphrases the frame ('infrastructure-as-product frame more than a slogan') without quoting verbatim — surveillance edge for a published-but-sparse-poster founder. Adapty hiring Infrastructure Team Lead actively (April 2025 post by Gregory) — secondary signal of capacity strain post-FunnelFox.

draft.subject_line: Reliability of the PSP control plane
draft.body:
Twelve days from the antitrust ruling to FunnelFox shipping with six PSPs integrated is the kind of execution that makes the infrastructure-as-product frame more than a slogan.

The corollary that follows: the control-plane that now holds those six integrations together — secret rotation across PSPs, IAM scoping, regional state — is part of the same product reliability surface, not a separate operational concern.

Transilience extends that reliability surface to control-plane state, with humans in the loop on remediation.

What instrumentation does the PSP control plane have today?
draft.architecture: signal-to-question — paraphrases his published frame, names the architectural extension, single product sentence, single open question CTA

verdict_history.reason: Opener earns existence by paraphrasing his published doctrine rather than echoing it. 'Frame more than a slogan' slightly clever but not blocking.

Cross-draft fix: dropped 'continuous' from product sentence to break the 4/4 'continuously' echo across the Adapty drafts. 'Extends that reliability surface' is inherently ongoing; the word was redundant. Substance carries.

witness.what_works: Subject is flat technical, names two specific things (PSP, control plane). Opener triangulates trigger (twelve-days post antitrust + FunnelFox + six PSPs) with his frame ('infrastructure-as-product more than a slogan'). Architectural extension is observation-not-pitch. Single product sentence. CTA invites engineering specificity.
witness.what_fails: Residual minor seam: 'is the kind of' opener appears in both Kirill and Gregory drafts. Non-blocking, would only surface in deliberate side-by-side comparison.

review_flags: coordinate-across-adapty-leads: four contacts at one 120-person founder-led co. Recommended sequencing in _company-summary.md.
